Subject: CVS SELLING BEER AND WINE IN MEADOW POINTE I1 
SAY NO TO CVS BOOZE 
UNDER CONSIDERATION FOR PASCO COUNTY COMMISSIONERS ON AUGUST 10, 2008 IS WHETHER TO LET 
CVS DRUGS SELL PACKAGED BEER AND WINE INSIDE MEADOW POINTE I1 SUBDIVISION IN WESLEY 
CHAPEL. THE CVS IS BEING CONSTRUCTED AT THE INTERSECTION OF COUNTY LINE ROAD AND MANSFIELD 
BLVD. ACROSS FROM THE MEADOW POINTE I1 RECREATION AREA AND CLUBHOUSE AND ACROSS THE STREET 
FROM A DAYCARE CENTER. IT IS VERY NEAR WIREGRASS HIGH SCHOOL, JOHN LONG MIDDLE SCHOOL AND 
SAND PINE ELEMENTARY. THIS HAS THE MAJORITY OF RESIDENTS CONCERNED ABOUT SAFETY AS WELL AS 
OTHER ISSUES 
ON WEDNESDAY JULY 16, 2008 THREE REPRESENTATIVES FROM CVS AGREED TO COME TO THE MEADOW 
POINTE I1 CDD MEETING TO EXPLAIN THEIR POINT OF VIEW AND ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS. THE CVS 
REPRESENTATIVES CONSISTED OF A LAWYER, CONSTRUCTION ENGINEER AND THE DISTRICT MANAGER. 
AFTER CORPORATE DIALOG BY THE LAWYER HAD REMARKS WHICH INCLUDED IT WAS A BEAUTIFUL 
COMMUNITY, LOOKS LIKE A GREAT PLACE TO LIVE AND RAISE KIDS, WE ( CVS ) WOULD LIKE TO BE 
PART OF YOUR COMMUNITY , AND BY THE WAY WE WANT TO SELL BEER AND WINE IN OUR STORE. THE 
ENGINEER EVEN WENT AS FAR AS SAYING SELLING BEER AND WINE WOULD REDUCE TRAFFIC. HOW? 
BECAUSE PEOPLE WILL WALK TO THE STORE IN 90+ DEGREE HEAT, TO BUY THEIR BEER AND WINE AND 
NOT TAKE THEIR CARS. APPARENTLY HE WAS NOT FAMILIAR WITH THE SIZE OF MEADOW POINTE AND 
DEFINITELY NOT FROM FLORIDA OR THE SOUTH! THE MAJORITY OF THE PEOPLE DID NOT WANT BEER OR 
WINE TO BE SOLD PERIOD. IF CVS WANTS TO BE PART OF OUR COMMUNITY THEY NEED TO DROP BEER 
AND WINE WHICH IS LESS THAN 2 PERCENT OF THEIR SALES AND CONCENTRATE ON 80 PERCENT OF 
THEIR SALES WHICH IS PHARMACUTICALS! THE MAJORITY OF RESIDENTS DON'T WANT BOOZE SOLD SO 
CLOSE TO SCHOOLS AND RECREATION AREAS NOT EVEN THE CONVENIENCE OF WALKING TO THE STORE AND 
POSSIBLY CAUSING MORE LITTER ON THE WAY HOME NOT TO MENTION A CHANCE OF UNDER AGE DRINKERS 
CONSUMING ALCOHOL AFTER IT WAS BOUGHT BY A LEGAL BUYER. WE APPRECIATE THE CVS COMING TO 
OUR MEETING BUT PLEASE DON'T PUT BOOZE IN YOUR STORE! THE DRINKERS CAN GO TO YOUR CVS 
STORE LOCATED AT SR 56 AND CR 581, A SHORT DISTANCE AWAY.. 
PASCO COUNTY COMMISSIONERS I PLEAD TO YOU TO SAY NO TO CVS BOOZE IN MEADOW POINTE I1 ON 
AUGUST lOTH ! ! ! ! ! ! !
